old_key.correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo. Usajilishaji wa hiari wa VAT unaruhusiwa. Faida kuu ni uwezo wa kudai VAT ya pembejeo kwenye manunuzi ya biashara. Wasiliana na TRA kwa maelezo ya mchakato wa usajilishaji wa hiari.
old_key.correct_answer_en: Yes. Voluntary VAT registration is permitted. The main advantage is the ability to claim input VAT credits on business purchases. Contact TRA for details on the voluntary registration process.

new_key.correct_answer_sw: Sheria ya VAT haitaji usajili wa hiari kwa mfanyabiashara aliyepo aliye chini ya kizingiti. Njia ilizotaja ni: kufikia kiwango, watoa huduma za kitaalamu, taasisi za Serikali, na anayetarajia kuanza biashara (kwa uamuzi wa Kamishna Mkuu). TRA inasema usajili wa hiari unaruhusiwa kwa shughuli maalum za kiuchumi bila kuzitaja. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kabla ya kuomba.
new_key.correct_answer_en: The VAT Act names no voluntary registration route for an existing trader below the threshold. The routes it names are: reaching the threshold, professional service providers, Government entities, and an intending trader (at the Commissioner General's discretion). TRA states voluntary registration is allowed for certain specific economic activities without naming them. Confirm with TRA (tra.go.tz) before applying.

old_key.correct_answer_en: 1) Contact TRA via tra.go.tz or nearest office. 2) Submit voluntary registration application with BRELA certificate, TIN, and business records. 3) TRA reviews your application. 4) If approved, you receive a VAT number and can issue VAT invoices and claim input VAT. new_key.correct_answer_en: No application procedure for voluntary registration is written for an existing trader below the threshold. Confirm with TRA (tra.go.tz).
